newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Luxembourg says has no plans to fix EMU rates.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg says has no plans to fix EMU rates.

text.p: Luxembourg Treasury Director Yves Mersch said on Wednesday that Luxembourg had no plans during its European Union presidency to fix conversion rates for currencies joining EMU.

"We do not have a plan to fix indicative (single currency) rates," Mersch told a European Parliament monetary subcommittee. "There is a difference between a discussion of how to fix indicative rates and actually fixing them."

Mersch said it was clear that one had to avoid a situation where financial markets were unclear over how exchange rates would be locked against the new single currency. But over the next six months, he said, the Luxembourg presidency had no specific mandate to actually devise a plan to fix the rates.
"There will probably be some informal discussions, but no formal procedures," Mersch said.
